purpose: Define the hard semantic separation between commercial licensing and technical certification: either may exist without the other unless a specific policy explicitly requires both.

topics.name: License and Certification Separation
topics.purpose: Define the hard semantic separation between commercial licensing and technical certification: either may exist without the other unless a specific policy explicitly requires both.

semantics.orthogonality_rule: License entitlement and certification status are separate facts.
semantics.policy_rule: A deployment/repository/customer policy may require certification in addition to licensing, but the requirement is explicit.
semantics.certification_price_rule: Certification commercial offering starts from €5,000 where applicable; commercial price is not certification evidence.
semantics.evidence_rule: Certification validity is anchored to certification/package evidence, not payment/license state.
semantics.license_rule: License validity is determined by license entitlement, not package certification hash.
semantics.runtime_rule: Neither license nor certification replaces IAM/AccessCore/runtime authorization.

invariants.rule: Commercial license entitlement, certification, identity, service availability and runtime authorization remain separate semantic dimensions.

hard_gates.condition: certification price/payment treated as technical evidence
package hash treated as license entitlement

prose.summary: Define the hard semantic separation between commercial licensing and technical certification: either may exist without the other unless a specific policy explicitly requires both.
